description: Start the public posterly signup for a user before posterly API access exists. A new account starts a 7-day free trial: Stripe Checkout collects a card, nothing is charged today, and the card is charged on day 8 unless the paid plan starts sooner. API and MCP stay limited during the trial. The API add-on is still required. Returns a signup poll URL, a browser Checkout handoff URL, and a payment object for that Checkout session (trial length, whether anything is charged today, merchant, and agent-wallet instructions). An account that already had a trial is charged at checkout instead. The user still sets a password and approves social OAuth in the browser. Never ask for card numbers, a posterly password, or social passwords in chat.

api_addon.description: Always true for AI agent setup because MCP/API access requires the API add-on.

debug.description: When true, include the raw signup response JSON for debugging. Keep false for normal user-facing agent flows.

email.description: User email address to sign up. Confirm this with the user before calling.

interval.description: Billing interval. Public agent signup currently supports monthly billing.

name.description: Optional user or workspace name to pass into posterly signup.

return_path.description: Where posterly should continue after checkout and password setup.

source.description: Source label for analytics and support diagnostics.

tier.description: posterly plan to start. Use starter unless the user explicitly chooses another plan.

tos_accepted.description: Set true only after the user has explicitly confirmed, in this conversation, that they accept the posterly terms at https://www.poster.ly/terms. Sending it here avoids a separate terms-confirmation step before client_secret is released.

name: start_signup
